snippet.title: The Last Errant - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4399690/The_Last_Errant/

The Last Errant is a challenging, turn-based tactical deckbuilder where every move counts. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, shape your playstyle through meaningful choices, and outthink your enemies on a grid-based battlefield with extreme replayability.
